messages:
Alex (AE): FYI, FluxCorp hit errors during the POC when trying to export traces to their Splunk instance. Priya attached a short stack snippet. Can SE + SRE swarm?

Priya (FluxCorp): Getting 429s on /v1/infer and many spans missing trace ids. Our app only logs req IDs, not Redwood trace ids. Example from our client logs: `req-6482` at 2024-07-10T12:01:23Z.

Maya (SE): Looking. Two quick Qs: do you have the raw request headers for that req-id? and what's the org id? We can enable verbose logs for a short window and push an export if you approve.

Priya (FluxCorp): I don't have trace headers — our client never set one. Org id is `flux-09`. I can DM the Splunk HEC token.

Jordan (SRE): We support correlation headers. Please have the client set `X-Redwood-Trace-Id` (any stable string) and `X-Request-Id`. Server will attach spans to that trace id. Example curl to reproduce:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -H "X-Redwood-Trace-Id: fc-20240710-001" \\n  -H "X-Request-Id: req-6482" \\n  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

Maya (SE): For the 429s, looks like they're hitting a short burst. We can temporarily bump their quota to 10 RPS for the POC window. That won't change billing for the POC; sustained increases need committed capacity.

Alex (AE): Good. Can we also enable debug request logs and set up an export to their Splunk? What security/legal do we need from FluxCorp?

Jordan (SRE): Two export options: 1) push to their Splunk HEC endpoint (we POST events) or 2) export zipped logs to an S3 bucket they control (we'll upload). For Splunk HEC we need the endpoint + HEC token + CORS/IP allowlist if their firewall restricts. For S3 we create a short-lived write role.

Jordan (SRE): Note on PI: we can redact model outputs and PII fields before export. Default hosted retention is 90 days; we can shorten/lengthen under an enterprise addendum. Security team will need written consent to export raw logs — please confirm.

Priya (FluxCorp): Confirm consent for 12:00-18:00 UTC tomorrow for debug logs and export. We want model outputs excluded from exports. Security also asked about PII redaction — how do you do that?

Maya (SE): We redact configurable JSON paths. Typical example: redact `choices[*].text`, `metadata.user_email`. Send list of fields you want masked and we'll apply before export.

Jordan (SRE): I'll provision a short-lived export role and enable org-scoped debug logs for `flux-09` from 12:00-18:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll also bump quota to 10 RPS for that window. Will monitor for cross-tenant impact and rollback if needed.

Alex (AE): What do you need from FluxCorp to proceed?

Maya (SE): Need these items: 1) confirmation of UTC window (12:00-18:00 tomorrow), 2) org id (`flux-09` provided), 3) example `req-id` and timestamp (you gave `req-6482` 2024-07-10T12:01:23Z), 4) Splunk HEC endpoint or S3 target + token/DM the token, 5) list of JSON paths to redact (e.g., `choices[*].text`). Also a signed export consent note (one-paragraph is fine).

Priya (FluxCorp): I'll DM the HEC token. Consent: "FluxCorp consents to temporary export of debug logs for org flux-09 between 2024-07-11T12:00Z and 2024-07-11T18:00Z for POC troubleshooting; model outputs must be excluded." Is that enough?

Jordan (SRE): That's fine. Quick tip: if they use streaming API, client must attach the *same* `X-Redwood-Trace-Id` for the whole session; otherwise you'll get fragmented traces per chunk.

Sam (support-bot): Deploybot: debug logging toggled for org `flux-09` by Jordan at 2024-07-10T11:05Z.

Maya (SE): Adding a sample correlated log line we emit so you can match on your side:

`[INFO] 2024-07-10T12:01:23Z req-6482 trace=fc-20240710-001 user=priya@fluxcorp.com latency=120ms status=200 model=redwood-13b`

Maya (SE): If you want full zipped export afterwards, DM me and I'll hand off the secure download link.

Priya (FluxCorp): :thumbsup: confirming the window, DMing token now, will send list of fields to redact. One question from our security team: will enabling debug logs for us degrade latency for other tenants?

Jordan (SRE): No — debug logging and export are org-scoped and buffered. We also rate-limit export throughput. If we detect cross-tenant impact we'll throttle/rollback immediately and notify.

Alex (AE): I'll update the SOW to state the temporary bump is included in the POC, and note that sustained increases will require Dedicated capacity pricing. I'll send a brief amendment after this thread.

Priya (FluxCorp): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround!

Maya (SE): Quick follow-up: after export completes we'll share a short log manifest (list of files + checksums) and a post-mortem if we see the 429 root cause is on our side.

Jordan (SRE): Logged tasks: 1) bump quota 12:00-18:00 UTC (done pending confirmation), 2) enable debug logs (done), 3) configure Splunk push (waiting for HEC token), 4) redact model outputs per field list.

Alex (AE): Great. Priya, once you send the fields & token we'll run the window.

Priya (FluxCorp): Sent token and field list in DM. Thanks all!
